# Cornelia Bryant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** Married
- **Origin:** Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c6 P33](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0033), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Cornelia has a fresh, round, pink-and-white face with jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is gathered into a hard little knob and kept in place by a tight elastic band under her sun-hat. She is ample in build and wears simple attire such as a striped apron over a chocolate print wrapper with pink rose designs.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c8 P22](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0022)_

## Personality

Miss Cornelia possesses a sharp, bitter tongue paired with an exceptionally kind heart. She holds strong, outspoken opinions, particularly exhibiting a chronic spite toward men and Methodists while being a staunch Presbyterian. Despite her critical remarks and inveterate man-hating views, she is dignified, practical, independent, and always the first to offer tender help to anyone in trouble.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c8 P37](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0037)_

## History

Miss Cornelia Bryant grew up in Four Winds, where she had many suitors in her youth but maintained a sharp disdain for men. Over the years, she established herself as an indispensable community figure, always stepping in to assist neighbors in distress and sew clothing for families in need. After Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe moved into their house of dreams at Four Winds, Miss Cornelia promptly called on them, bringing hand-embroidered baby clothes she was sewing for a local family. She quickly became a close friend and frequent visitor to Anne, sharing local news, entertaining anecdotes, and the tragic past of her best friend, Leslie Moore. Eventually, Miss Cornelia surprised her community by marrying Marshall Elliott.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P23](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0023), [v4 c10 P24](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0024), [v4 c10 P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Had her pick of suitors when young  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- Her father was named Stephen
- Won first prize for lemon pies at the Charlottetown Exhibition  <sub>[v4 c10 P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035)</sub>
